title: Chest
wikitext:
{{for|chest-like objects that also spawn packs of monsters|strongbox}}

'''Chests''' are interactable objects found throughout various areas that can be opened, broken, or activated to drop random or specific items. 

Chests generally drop items at the same level as the area level, and are affected by modifiers to area [[item quantity]].<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mws3vomtyYU</ref> They are not affected by player quantity.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IUMqbMJ4jmM</ref>

==List of loot containers==

===Generic environmental containers===
Generic environment containers are generated as part of specific tilesets. They may generate in random and in multiples. They generally have more generic and less desirable rewards.

===Specific environment containers===
These containers are found in specific, more deterministic places and generally have more specific and desirable rewards. They are rarely generated in multiples.

* [[Vaal Vessel]] - found in [[Vaal side area|Vaal side areas]]
* [[Izaro's Treasure]] - found in [[the Lord's Labyrinth]]; requires a {{il|Treasure Key}} to open
* [[Abyssal Trove]] - reward chest by completing an [[Abyss]] encounter
* [[Hoards]] - found in [[Abyssal Depths]] from an Abyss encounter; also spawned by Abysses with {{il|Abyss Scarab of Edifice}}
* [[Large Chest]] - in certain maps
* [[Large Chest The Twilight Strand (Act 1)|Large Chest]] - (The Twilight Strand (Act 1))
* [[Pirate's Treasure]]
* [[Perandus chest]] - found in areas with [[Perandus]] monsters, such as [[Perandus Manor]] (legacy content).

===Relic chests===
Relic Vaults are found in special Reliquary zones accessed via [[Reliquary Key]] items; contains [[foil]] uniques.

Singular Reliquary chests are found in {{il|Valdo's Puzzle Box}} maps after completing the map; contains [[foil]] unique.

===Heist===
Chests related to [[Heist]].

* [[Smuggler's Cache]] - can contain {{il|Rogue's Marker|Rogue's Markers}}, [[Contract|Contracts]] and [[Blueprint|Blueprints]].
* [[Curio Display]] - found in the final reward room of a Heist / Grand Heist zone.

The following small chests are specific to one or two Heist tilesets. They will drop random loot of a specific type such as weapons, armour, currency, essences and jewellery.
* [[Secure Locker]]
* [[Ornate Crate]]
* [[Small Bronze Chest]]
